initial_weights_source: Local completed b0_s960_v1 best checkpoint; provenance in experiment.json, not a new download
paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: AdamW paper compares AdamW and momentum SGD on image classification, not CCTV accident detection. STTAD uses 16-frame 2D+3D STFN, AdamW with 1e-4/1e-5/1e-6 schedule and batch32 on RTX4090; this is a single-frame YOLOv8s adaptation, NOT a reproduction. This experiment changes only optimizer AdamW to SGD against version10 while fixing remaining training arguments, data and initial checkpoint; same numeric lr is a controlled reference, not an optimal or equivalent step size.
experiment_purpose: Version9 SGD had higher same-val mAP than version10 AdamW, but changed multiple factors. Isolate the optimizer by changing only AdamW to SGD relative to version10, keeping seed, initial weights, data and schedule; compare mAP, recall, FP and per-source/size errors on validation. No claim of guaranteed improvement.
hardware_decision: One free T4 GPU0; batch8, AMP, workers2, imgsz960, 3-step real-train backwards/SGD optimizer smoke. Ultralytics may reduce batch on first-epoch OOM; actual logs must be checked. No GPU-independent quality claim.

secondary_checks: Fixed confidence.25/IoU.5 precision,recall,F1 and negative-image FP rate on same enlarged val
Prior217-image validation subset retained via source provenance for diagnosing recall drift

limitations: Single seed; SGD and AdamW have different update scales at the same nominal learning rate. Previously reused 307-image validation cannot be an unbiased final test. No additional independent positive events or labels, no guarantee of 70 percent, no event performance claim.
training_mode: One new run from the same original s960 starting checkpoint; not resume and no transfer from either completed Kaggle run.
migration_note: Original bundle untouched. Relative to completed AdamW v2, optimizer is the only change to training hyperparameters; code probe supports SGD and paths/metadata describe the new run. Test/reserve excluded.
